title: AdminFlagged
description: GET /api/admin/flagged, for admins only. Person profiles in the loaded snapshot whose name has the shape of a company or group: its last word names a trade or a legal form, as in Digital, Health, Medical, Photonics, AG, GmbH, Ltd, Lab, Group or Center. The rule reads word shapes, never a list of names, and removes nothing: a person checks each one against its page.

checked.description: How many person profiles the rule looked at.

page_url.description: The page the profile was read from, where a person checks the name.

reason.description: The word that gave the shape, as "ends in Digital".
